: Not all oath are from the Trolloc Wars. The oath of not make weapons was the first, made in the War of Power or the Breaking. I'm not sure, but I AM sure it was before the Trolloc Wars. [[User:Asha&#39;man Leyrann Gaidin|Asha&#39;man Leyrann Gaidin]] 15:28, June 15, 2011 (UTC)
